_comment: Local image generation via LocalAI (https://localai.io), which serves the
tool calls. NOTE: LM Studio cannot generate images (no diffusion backend);
use LocalAI / ComfyUI+shim / SD WebUI+proxy for the `image` role.
Several `image`-role models are configured so the agent can pick one per
workflow via generate_image's `model` arg; each carries a `description` the
tool schema and /status surface. The Kontext model is for editing (the
generate_image `source` argument). apiBase ends in /v1; local servers need
no key. Copy to local/config.json (git-ignored) or point --config at it.
See docs/MEDIA_GEN.md for LocalAI setup + the ~16 GB VRAM model table.
